name: What information should I have ready for my site feasibility consultation?

mainEntity.name: What information should I have ready for my site feasibility consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make your site feasibility consultation most effective, please have readily available your property address or assessor's parcel number (APN). Any existing surveys, plot plans, or environmental reports for the property are also helpful. Additionally, be prepared to discuss your vision for the tiny home, including its approximate size, intended use, and any specific utility requirements you may have.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have your property address, any existing surveys or plot plans, and be ready to discuss your tiny home vision and utility needs.
